comparison.objective: Candidate commissions and locks a robot-axis shock absorber by tuning dynamic stopping response; record cleans a coil strainer and restores a balancing valve to its prior notch.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires recessed hex-key engagement, setscrew release, fine collar rotation, counterholding, relocking, and test cycling; record indicates strainer handling and valve repositioning.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two safe 0.85 J-or-greater stops within 12 mm without bottoming, rebound, overload, hard-stop contact, or drift. Record provides no body, specs, setup, or scoring beyond restoring the valve notch.
comparison.reason: Cleaning and restoring a valve position tests a different maintenance outcome from iterative dynamic-energy tuning and retention of a damper; generic adjustment does not establish overlap.
